Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that juice in a freezer would become a gas due to sugar content. Sugar lowers the freezing point (it doesn’t cause gas formation at freezer temperatures), so the juice would most likely become a solid (or slushy), not a gas. This flawed physical reasoning led to choosing C instead of the correct D.
